english.title: Make a false / misleading statement for use for the purpose of setting a relevant benchmark
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a false or misleading statement, namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT..), to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) in the course of arrangements for the setting of a relevant benchmark, namely **(..SPECIFY BENCHMARK..), intending that the statement should be used by

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

for the purpose of the setting of a relevant benchmark and knowing that the statement was false or misleading or being reckless as to whether it was
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 91(1) and 92 of the Financial Services Act 2012.

english.notes:
(i) Investment includes any asset, right or interest.
(ii) Relevant agreement means an agreement -
(a) the entering into or performance of which by either party constitutes an activity of a kind specified in an order made by the Treasury, and (b) which relates to a relevant investment.
(iii) Relevant benchmark means a benchmark of a kind specified in an order made by the Treasury.
(iv) Relevant investment means an investment of a kind specified in an order made by the Treasury.
(v) SI 2021/1173 amended the penalty for this offence with effect from 1st November 2021. For an offence that is committed on or after that date use this offence wording. For an offence that is committed before that date, see H12574.
(vi) Where an offence is found to be committed over a period of two or more days, or at some point during a period of two or more days, it is to be taken to have been committed on the first of those days, see section 31(4) of the Financial Services Act 2021.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Note: The reference to 'Twelve months imprisonment' should be read as a reference to 'Six months imprisonment' until the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003.

Time limit for prosecution:
None
